name: Wix read-only access smoke test — products and orders
purpose: Confirm that the connected Wix integration can read a bounded sample of visible products and recent orders without changing site data.
source: Wix Stores Catalog V3 Query Products and Wix eCommerce Search Orders APIs
observed_at: 2026-10-12T06:30:00Z (approximate tool-run time; not a source timestamp)
date_range: Products: first 5 visible catalog results; orders: first 5 returned by default order search, latest created first.
sample_size: 5 products and 5 orders returned; both responses indicate more results are available.
steps_performed: Captured only minimal aggregate/product/order fields; no customer personal data retained in this test record.
result: Both Wix APIs returned HTTP 200. Five visible physical products and five approved orders were returned. This confirms read access for the tested endpoints and sample only; it does not establish full historical completeness or all agent permissions.
limitations: Only first page of 5 records was sampled.
Order response uses endpoint defaults; no claim that it is a complete ledger or revenue report.
Product query response did not expose price in the selected fields; pricing/variant completeness was not tested.
freshness: Live API response at test time; order records shown include dates from 2026-08-17 to 2026-09-27.
confidence_rationale: Both documented read-only endpoints returned HTTP 200 and representative records; broader coverage was not tested.
